top_story.headline: GRV Strategies amends its Qatar filing to add activity it left out of its last supplemental statement
top_story.dek: The Washington firm told the Justice Department it did additional work for Qatar's International Media Office that was not reported for the period ending March 31, 2026.
paragraphs: GRV Strategies LLC (registration #7458) filed an amendment on October 27, 2026, stamped received by the National Security Division's FARA Registration Unit at 12:36 p.m. The amendment says it reports "additional activities on behalf of the International Media office of State of Qatar that was previously not reported on Supplemental Statement ending 3/31/2026 in Item 12." Item 12 is the section on political activity for a foreign principal.

The appendix amends the Item 12 response for the six-month period ending March 31, 2026. It describes the work as media communications "to promote positive relations with the State of Qatar." The amendment was signed October 27 by Garrett Ventry, almost seven months after that period closed. The OCR text available to this edition cuts off before the itemized activities, so the specific outreach is not described here. GRV Strategies also filed a separate supplemental statement the same day, linked below.
No contact between GRV Strategies and the President, Vice President or a cabinet official turned up in today's search of FARA filings.

sections.headline: Termination notices pending OGE disposition; two appointees file ethics compliance certifications
paragraphs: Two White House nominees submitted ethics agreement termination notices, both awaiting final OGE disposition. Two confirmed appointees filed ethics agreement certifications: James Middleton (Farm Credit Administration Board Member) submitted his initial ethics agreement October 30, and Erin Browne (Treasury Under Secretary for International Affairs) certified compliance with her March 2026 agreement on October 26, reporting completed divestitures and a PIMCO bonus received prior to confirmation.

items: William T. McMurry, Designated Agency Ethics Official, National Transportation Safety Board — Termination notice (Pending Final OGE Disposition). Request this Document.
Manuel P. Micaller, Ambassador to Tajikistan, Department of State — Termination notice (Pending Final OGE Disposition). Request this Document.

James Middleton, Member, Farm Credit Administration Board, Farm Credit Administration — Ethics Agreement. Signed October 27, 2026. Middleton committed to recusal from matters directly affecting his financial interests and disclosed ownership of agricultural real estate in Throckmorton County, Texas, leased to a third party.

Erin Browne, Under Secretary for International Affairs, Department of the Treasury — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance. Certified October 26, 2026. Browne reported completing all required divestitures (filed transaction report September 3, 2026), all resignations, and compliance with recusal obligations. She disclosed receipt of a PIMCO bonus prior to her August 7, 2026 confirmation.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
